items.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: square wiki catalogue tile illustration
Primary request: portray Ammon as a respectful historically plausible ancient people or nation, clearly recognizable at thumbnail size
Biblical context for subject selection: De Ammonieten stamden volgens Genesis af van Ben-Ammi, de jongste zoon van Lot. Hun historische kerngebied lag ten oosten van de Jordaan, rond hun hoofdstad Rabba. In Gods Woord komen zij voor als verwant buurvolk van Israël, als tegenstander en soms als deel van Israëls samenleving.
Scene/backdrop: sparse historically fitting ground or setting dissolving naturally into plain warm aged parchment with delicate fibers and subtle patina
Style/medium: highly refined historical ethnographic plate in fine navy-gray pencil contours with restrained transparent watercolor washes, exactly matching the supplied approved Open Vertaling reference illustration
Composition/framing: square, one clear central subject or one restrained coherent group, full silhouette visible, generous clean margins, no panorama or busy background
Lighting/mood: gentle warm side light, quiet, dignified and reverent
Color palette: parchment cream, sand, muted antique gold, faded olive, warm brown and deep navy-gray; low saturation
Constraints: subject and period details must be plausible; no text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, artist signature, corner mark, frame, border, watermark, modern objects, halo, dramatic rays, fantasy ornament, crowded action, cartoon style or photorealism
